questions.question: While Israel was staying in Shittim, what did the daughters of Moab invite the Israelite men to?
After Phinehas drove a spear through an Israelite man and a Midianite woman, what happened to the Israelites?

answers.text: The plague against them was halted
They broke camp and left Shittim

questions.question: Because Phinehas turned away the LORD's wrath from Israel, what did the LORD say He was granting him?
Why did the LORD tell Moses to attack the Midianites?

answers.text: They deceived Israel in the matter of Peor
They blocked Israel's road into Canaan
They raided Israel's camp in the night
